description: This Java class 'SpringCacheProvider' implements the 'CacheProvider' interface and provides a way to get cache instances using Spring's CacheManager, encapsulating the creation of a 'SpringBasedExpiringValueCache'.

classes.name: SpringCacheProvider
classes.description: A cache manager based on Spring Cache that provides expiring value cache instances.

methods.name: SpringCacheProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache provider with a Spring CacheManager, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache by name from the CacheManager and wraps it in a SpringBasedExpiringValueCache if available.
